# Imported scientific generators

These files are copied without modifications from the pinned commits in
`../upstream.json`. Each repository's original MIT license is included. The
record also lists original paths and SHA-256 checksums for every imported file.

Only generator sources and their required headers are imported. Simulation
outputs, analyzers, cluster credentials, and full source Git histories are not
copied. The upstream repository links preserve access to development history.

The adapters in `../src/backends/` rename each `main` during compilation. Keep
changes to the common interface outside these imported files. Source version
constants in the executable are generated by CMake from `upstream.json`.
